checks.title: Manual: review Entra ID Global Administrators count (small + named)
checks.audit: az role assignment list --role 'Global Administrator' --all -o table. Confirm Global Admin count is small (typically <= 5), all named individuals, no service principals.
checks.rationale: Global Administrators are the highest-privilege identity in the tenant.
checks.remediation: Re-assign privileges via PIM-eligible role activation; remove standing Global Admin rights.

checks.title: Manual: Entra ID MFA enforced for all admins (Conditional Access)
checks.audit: Entra ID > Conditional Access > Policies. Confirm a CA policy targets all admin roles and requires MFA, with no exclusions other than break-glass accounts.
checks.rationale: Admin MFA is the single most important Entra ID control.
checks.remediation: Create a CA policy: Users=All admins, Cloud apps=All, Grant=Require MFA.

checks.title: Manual: legacy auth blocked via Conditional Access
checks.audit: Entra ID > Conditional Access. Confirm a CA policy blocks 'Other clients' / legacy authentication for all users.
checks.rationale: Legacy auth (POP, IMAP, SMTP AUTH) bypasses MFA.
checks.remediation: Create a CA policy blocking legacy authentication for all users.

checks.title: Subscription has Microsoft Defender for Cloud Standard enabled
checks.command: az security pricing list --query "value[?pricingTier=='Standard'] | length(@)" -o tsv 2>/dev/null
checks.rationale: Defender Standard provides agent-based threat protection across plans.
checks.remediation: az security pricing create --name VirtualMachines --tier Standard (repeat per relevant plan).

checks.title: Manual: Storage Accounts deny public blob access by default
checks.audit: az storage account list --query '[].{name:name,allowBlobPublicAccess:allowBlobPublicAccess}' -o table. Confirm allowBlobPublicAccess=false for all accounts.
checks.rationale: Public blob containers have leaked sensitive data across many published incidents.

checks.title: Manual: SQL servers / SQL Managed Instances enforce TLS 1.2 minimum
checks.audit: az sql server list --query '[].{name:name,minimalTlsVersion:minimalTlsVersion}' -o table. Confirm minimalTlsVersion='1.2'.
checks.rationale: TLS 1.0/1.1 are deprecated and PCI-DSS non-compliant.

checks.title: Manual: Network Security Group default rules audited (no 0.0.0.0/0 to admin ports)
checks.audit: az network nsg list --query '[].securityRules[?direction==`Inbound` && (destinationPortRange==`3389` || destinationPortRange==`22`) && sourceAddressPrefix==`*`].id' -o tsv. Should be empty.
checks.rationale: RDP/SSH exposed to the internet is a top initial-access vector.
checks.remediation: Replace 0.0.0.0/0 SourceAddressPrefix with specific IPs or Just-In-Time access via Defender for Cloud.

checks.title: Manual: Key Vault soft-delete and purge protection enabled
checks.audit: az keyvault list --query '[].{name:name,softDelete:properties.enableSoftDelete,purgeProtection:properties.enablePurgeProtection}' -o table. Confirm both true.
checks.rationale: Soft-delete + purge protection prevent accidental/malicious key destruction.

checks.title: Manual: Activity Log retention + diagnostic settings configured to Log Analytics
checks.audit: az monitor diagnostic-settings subscription list -o table. Confirm at least one setting forwards Activity Log to Log Analytics (or Storage with retention).
checks.rationale: Without retention + central logging, breach forensics are impossible.
checks.remediation: az monitor diagnostic-settings subscription create with --workspace pointing at your Sentinel/LA workspace.

checks.title: Manual: Microsoft Sentinel or equivalent SIEM is consuming Activity / Sign-in / Audit logs
checks.audit: In Sentinel, confirm data connectors for 'Azure Activity' and 'Microsoft Entra ID' are Connected.
checks.rationale: SIEM correlation enables detection of identity attacks and lateral movement.
checks.remediation: Enable the Azure Activity and Entra ID connectors in Sentinel.
